subject: pharmacology
title: Other antibacterials: fluoroquinolones, vancomycin, metronidazole and UTI drugs

steps.tx: **Fluoroquinolones** (**ciprofloxacin** UTI and anthrax, **levofloxacin** respiratory, **moxifloxacin** anaerobic with TB masking; DNA gyrase and topoisomerase) carry **tendinopathy with aortic dissection**, **QT prolongation**, **myasthenia worsening**, CNS excitation and dysglycaemia; children avoid (cartilage), cations block absorption (iron, antacids spaced), theophylline and warfarin interact. Reserve (culture guided, TB symptoms first) curbs resistance; traveller's standby debates continue.
steps.say: Tendons snap and aortas split on fluoroquinolones: reserve cultures. Cations block: space iron and antacids.

steps.tx: **Metronidazole** (nitroimidazole, anaerobes above and below diaphragm, **amoeba and Giardia**, **C. difficile** oral, H. pylori quadruple, rosacea) causes **disulfiram reaction** with alcohol, metallic taste with neuropathy chronic, and dark urine harmless; warfarin potentiates (INR watched). **Vancomycin** (glycopeptide, MRSA IV, **C. diff oral** with fidaxomicin recurrences, **red man syndrome** rate related with antihistamine premedication, nephrotoxicity with ototoxicity, **AUC monitoring**) stays first where susceptible.
steps.say: Alcohol on metronidazole vomits disulfiram-like. Fast vancomycin reddens necks: slow infusion, AUC dose.

steps.tx: **Daptomycin** (lipopeptide, MRSA bacteraemia with endocarditis, **lungs fail** surfactant bound, **CPK myopathy** with statins watched, eosinophilic pneumonia) with **TMP-SMX** (UTI, **PCP**, Nocardia, Stenotrophomonas, Listeria alternative; **hyperkalaemia**, SJS, **kernicterus** neonates avoided, warfarin and phenytoin interact) covers niches; **nitrofurantoin** (**cystitis only**, no kidney or blood, chronic **lung fibrosis**, G6PD haemolysis) and **fosfomycin** (single dose cystitis, VRE) finish bladders. Pregnancy UTI (nitrofurantoin term caution, fosfomycin, amoxicillin; FQ and TMP avoided) guides.
steps.say: Daptomycin never lungs: surfactant binds. TMP-SMX kernicteruses neonates: avoid. Cystitis only nitrofurantoin fibroses lungs chronic.

steps.tx: **Last resorts** (colistin polymyxin with nephrotoxicity and neurotoxicity for carbapenem resistant Gram negatives, ceftazidime avibactam KPC, cefiderocol siderophore) with **stewardship** (cultures before antibiotics, de-escalation 48 to 72 hours, surgical source control, duration caps: cystitis 3 to 5 days, pneumonia 5 to 7, bacteraemia 2 weeks uncomplicated) preserve cures; **antibiograms** localise empiric picks. Hand hygiene with isolation outranks new drugs.
steps.say: Cultures first, narrow at 72 hours, short courses cure: stewardship saves drugs. Colistin kidneys and nerves price rescue.
